# Workbook fields and where they are stored

<!-- GENERATED by gea/tools/generate.py - do not edit by hand. -->

Source: `PLRe_GEA_UX_UI_Functional_Specification_v5.xlsx#POC Data` (rows 5 to 40). One line per row of that sheet; Prop, Display name,
Step, Type, Control and Required are the workbook's own columns. Every prop is a column of
gea."Project" or gea."Run", or rows of a child table when it is a list of date ranges or a multiselect
of a lookup. To change a field: edit `poc-data.json`, add an Alembic revision for the column and run
`python gea/tools/generate.py`; `tests/gea/test_migration_sql.py` fails until the three agree.

## Create project (`createProject.*`)

| Prop | Display name | Step | Type | Control | Required | Stored in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | Project name | Main | `string` | text input | yes | `Project`.`Name` text |
| `region` | Region | Main | `string` | select | yes | `Project`.`RegionId` text -> `Region` |
| `businessPurpose` | Business purpose | Main | `string` | select | yes | `Project`.`BusinessPurposeId` text -> `BusinessPurpose` |
| `benefit` | Benefit | Main | `array<string>` | multiselect | yes | `ProjectBenefit`.`BenefitId` (one row per value) |
